title: Schneider Electric Modicon
summary: Modicon controllers range from M241/M251/M262 logic and motion controllers (EcoStruxure Machine Expert) to the M580 process ePAC (EcoStruxure Control Expert).

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body:
| Family | Role |
| --- | --- |
| Modicon M241 / M251 | Logic controllers for machines, TM3 expansion I/O |
| Modicon M262 | Logic and motion controller |
| Modicon M580 | Ethernet-based process controller (ePAC), X80 I/O |

sections.heading: Engineering
sections.body: Machine controllers are programmed in EcoStruxure Machine Expert (CODESYS-based); M580 in EcoStruxure Control Expert. Both follow IEC 61131-3 languages.
